name: Voxel Grid Ray Marching
definition: An algorithm to traverse a 3D voxel grid along a ray, returning the IDs of all visited cells. It handles rays starting outside the grid by computing the entry point intersection with the bounding box.
summary: Voxel Grid Ray Marching traverses a 3D voxel grid along a ray to return all visited cell IDs, distinguishing itself by processing every voxel rather than stopping at the first hit.
